Q1_where_to_add_check.answer: Add validate_catalog_hash() function to planner.py. Call it from plan_scenarios() at the top, before building any scenarios. Also callable standalone from runner.py _stage_scenario_planning().
Q1_where_to_add_check.rationale: planner.py is the single place where catalog is consumed for scenario building. Hash check at entry point catches drift before any planning work.

Q2_what_hash_to_compare.answer: Compute SHA-256 of the JSON-serialized catalog dict (json.dumps with sort_keys=True, no indent). Compare against denominator's api_catalog_sha256 field.
Q2_what_hash_to_compare.rationale: Canonical JSON serialization ensures deterministic hash. sort_keys=True prevents key-order changes from triggering false mismatches.

Q3_where_to_find_denominator.answer: pipeline/configs/denominators/{family}.json — loaded by a new helper function _load_denominator_hash(family, repo_root).
Q3_where_to_find_denominator.rationale: Denominator files already exist for all 6 families with api_catalog_sha256 fields.

Q4_behavior_on_mismatch.answer: Log WARNING and return a CatalogHashResult with mismatch=True, prior_hash, current_hash. Do NOT raise an exception by default — the pipeline should continue but record the mismatch in evidence. An optional strict=True parameter raises CatalogHashMismatchError.
Q4_behavior_on_mismatch.rationale: Non-blocking by default avoids breaking monthly reruns when a new package version changes the catalog. The mismatch is recorded in evidence for governance review. Strict mode available for CI enforcement.

Q5_new_function_signature.answer: validate_catalog_hash(family: str, catalog: dict, repo_root: Path, strict: bool = False) -> CatalogHashResult

Q6_integration_point.answer: Called from plan_scenarios() with new optional repo_root parameter. Also write evidence artifact catalog-hash-validation.json to evidence_dir.
Q6_integration_point.rationale: plan_scenarios already takes family and catalog. Adding optional repo_root (default None = skip check) is backward compatible.

Q7_hash_computation.rationale: Deterministic, reproducible, matches how denominator files were originally computed.

Q8_what_if_no_denominator.answer: If denominator file doesn't exist, return CatalogHashResult with match=None (indeterminate), log INFO. No failure.
Q8_what_if_no_denominator.rationale: Some families may not have denominator files yet. Graceful degradation.

Q9_evidence_artifact.answer: Write catalog-hash-validation.json to evidence_dir with: family, current_hash, denominator_hash, match, denominator_path, validated_at.
Q9_evidence_artifact.integration: Written by runner.py _stage_scenario_planning() after calling validate_catalog_hash().

Q10_backward_compatibility.answer: plan_scenarios() gains optional repo_root parameter (default None). When None, hash check is skipped. All existing callers and tests unaffected.

Q11_test_plan.answer: 9 tests: hash computation deterministic, match passes, mismatch detected, missing denominator graceful, strict mode raises, plan_scenarios accepts repo_root, evidence artifact written, hash differs on catalog change, unknown family graceful.
